items.title: Home Depot stock setup analysis into tomorrow’s earnings
items.summary: Investing.com -- Home Depot Inc (HD) reports tomorrow, Nov 17, before the open. Consensus is EPS $3.84 on revenue of $42.81B. The stock last closed at $348.69 (Nov 13, 3:59 PM EST), and pre-market was $349.32 as of Nov 16, 9:20 AM EST. That is flat, so the market isn’t paying up ahead of the print.
